name: hgi_sm_xload_cl_ref-cl1-COMMIT
purpose: Structural successor of st2 (H-SM 2026-10-15): measured st2 defects = 57,188 FFs on one clock root and two mask nets x 4,096 SRAM mask pins (floorplan repair stalled -383 ps / 9,689 endpoints). Fix: bank-local mask capture always on (64 kept mask FFs at the SRAMs, same write edge) + five related phase-0 CTS roots split by function from the actual mapped census (clk 9.6k, clk_bf 13.9k, clk_qlo 12.6k, clk_qhi 12.6k, clk_bd 8.5k, each < 15k). No stage/calendar/compiler change.
